title: What If You Trained in SECRET for 90 Days for Your CRUSH?
tags: what if you trained for 90 days
description:
Your crush laughed when you slid down the rope in gym class. So you make a plan: 90 days, no gym, no money, no days off, and nobody can find out. Every night at 11 PM you hit your bedroom floor for push-ups, while a light in the window across the street goes off at exactly 11:04. On day 90 there's a rope, a bell, and the guy who dared you in front of everyone.

Two questions for the comments:
1) How many days could you train in secret without missing a single one?
2) Would you have told her about the training, or kept the secret until day 90?

Subscribe, and I'll see you on day 91.


Real facts in this episode:

• Push-ups can build as much muscle as the bench press when the effort is the same (Kikuchi & Nakazato, 2017, 8 weeks).
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/29541130/

• Next-day soreness is not lactic acid. It comes from tiny tears in the muscle fibers and peaks 24 to 72 hours later.
https://www.houstonmethodist.org/blog/articles/2021/oct/is-lactic-acid-buildup-really-what-causes-muscle-soreness-after-a-workout/

• In the first weeks of training, most new strength comes from your nervous system, not from bigger muscles.
https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7892509/

• The biggest pulse of growth hormone comes shortly after you fall asleep, during the first deep sleep.
https://pubmed.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/8627466/

• A new habit takes about 66 days on average to feel automatic (from 18 to 254), and missing one day does not ruin it (University College London).
https://www.ucl.ac.uk/news/2009/aug/how-long-does-it-take-form-habit
